arxiv-2404-13079.title: Relational Graph Convolutional Networks for Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2404-13079.creator: Asal Khosravi, Zahed Rahmati, Ali Vefghi
arxiv-2404-13079.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Asal Khosravi, Zahed Rahmati, Ali Vefghi. With the growth of textual data across online platforms, sentiment analysis has become crucial for extracting insights from user-generated content. While traditional approaches and deep learning models have shown promise, they cannot often capture complex relationships between entities. In this paper, we propose leveraging Relational Graph Convolutional Networks (RGCNs) for sentiment analysis, which offer interpretability and flexibility by capturing dependencies between data points represented as nodes in a graph.

arxiv-2405-20182.title: Convergence Analysis for A Stochastic Maximum Principle Based Data Driven Feedback Control Algorithm
arxiv-2405-20182.creator: Siming Liang, Hui Sun, Richard Archibald, Feng Bao
arxiv-2405-20182.description: Abstract This paper presents convergence analysis of a novel data-driven feedback control algorithm designed for generating online controls based on partial noisy observational data. The algorithm comprises a particle filter-enabled state estimation component, estimating the controlled system’s state via indirect observations, alongside an efficient stochastic maximum principle type optimal control solver.

arxiv-2410-06078.title: Neutron Stars and Dark Matter
arxiv-2410-06078.creator: Antonino Del Popolo, Morgan Le Delliou *, Maksym Deliyergiyev
arxiv-2410-06078.description: Abstract Neutron stars change their structure with accumulation of dark matter. We study how their mass is influenced from the environment. Close to the sun, the dark matter accretion from the neutron star does not have any effect on it. Moving towards the galactic center, the density increase in dark matter results in increased accretion.

arxiv-2410-24038.title: Acceleration and Focusing Electron/Positron Bunches in Plasma-Dielectric Wakefield Accelerator Journal: Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research A
arxiv-2410-24038.creator: Gennadiy V. Sotnikov, Kostyantyn V. Galaydych, Jay L. Hirshfield, Peter I. Markov, Ivan M. Onishchenko
arxiv-2410-24038.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gennadiy V. Sotnikov, Kostyantyn V. Galaydych, Jay L. Hirshfield, Peter I. Markov, Ivan M. Onishchenko. Аннотация To mitigate the BBU instability and improve characteristics of accelerated bunches in Dielectric Wakefield Accelerator one can be used the isotropic plasma filling of the transport channel. Here we present the results of analytical and numerical studies of the dynamics of accelerated electron/positron and drive electron bunches under wake acceleration in a plasma DWA (PDWA) with a vacuum channel.

arxiv-2411-11400.title: A coordinate-free approach to obtaining exact solutions in general relativity: The Newman-Unti-Tamburino solution revisited
arxiv-2411-11400.creator: Emir Baysazan, Ayşe Hümeyra Bilge, Tolga Birkandan, Tekin Dereli
arxiv-2411-11400.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Emir Baysazan, Ayşe Hümeyra Bilge, Tolga Birkandan, Tekin Dereli. The Newman-Unti-Tamburino (NUT) solution is characterized as the unique Petrov Type D D vacuum metric such that the two double principal null directions form an integrable distribution. The uniqueness of the NUT is established by evaluating the integrability conditions of the Newman-Penrose equations up to S ​ L ​ ( 2 , ℂ ) SL(2,\mathbb{C}) transformations, resulting in a coordinate-free characterization of the solution.

arxiv-2510-21524.title: EU-Agent-Bench: Measuring Illegal Behavior of LLM Agents Under EU Law
arxiv-2510-21524.creator: Ilija Lichkovski, Alexander Müller, Mariam Ibrahim, Tiwai Mhundwa
arxiv-2510-21524.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ilija Lichkovski, Alexander Müller, Mariam Ibrahim, Tiwai Mhundwa. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents in various contexts by providing tools at their disposal. However, LLM agents can exhibit unpredictable behaviors, including taking undesirable and/or unsafe actions.

pmc-10801708.title: Combinatorial immune refocusing within the influenza hemagglutinin RBD improves cross-neutralizing antibody responses
pmc-10801708.creator: Annie Dosey, Daniel Ellis, Seyhan Boyoglu-Barnum, Hubza Syeda, Mason Saunders, Michael J. Watson, John C. Kraft, Minh N. Pham, Miklos Guttman, Kelly K. Lee, Masaru Kanekiyo, Neil P. King
pmc-10801708.description: SUMMARYThe receptor-binding domain (RBD) of influenza virus hemagglutinin (HA) elicits potently neutralizing yet mostly strain-specific antibodies. Here, we evaluate the ability of several immunofocusing techniques to enhance the functional breadth of vaccine-elicited immune responses against the HA RBD. We present a series of “trihead” nanoparticle immunogens that display native-like closed trimeric RBDs from the HAs of several H1N1 influenza viruses.

pmc-11345270.title: Association between TMPRSS2 rs2070788 polymorphism and COVID-19 severity: a case-control study in multiple cities of Iran
pmc-11345270.creator: Arezoo Faridzadeh, Mahmoud Mahmoudi, Bahman Rahimlou, Mohammad Mehdi Naghizadeh, Tooba Ghazanfari
pmc-11345270.description: IntroductionHost genetic variations have been identified as potential influencers of COVID-19 infection. This study aimed to examine the association between transmembrane serine protease type 2 (TMPRSS2) rs2070788 single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) and the prognosis of COVID-19 in Iranian populations.MethodThis case-control study was performed on 756 COVID-19 patients and 59 healthy individuals across Iran.

pmc-11510124.creator: Nasif Hossain, Lina Madaniyazi, Chris Fook Sheng Ng, Dilruba Nasrin, Xerxes Tesoro Seposo, Paul L. C. Chua, Rui Pan, Abu Syed Golam Faruque, Masahiro Hashizume, Justin V. pmc-11510124.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundDiarrhoeal diseases cause a heavy burden in developing countries. pmc-11547146.title: A New Feasible Opportunity for Recycling Lead and Silver from Zinc Plant Residues by Flotation
pmc-11547146.creator: Hossein Kamran Haghighi, Fatemeh Sadat Hoseinian, Ana Maria Sastre
pmc-11547146.description: Millions of tons of zinc plant leach residues (ZPLR) have been stockpiled in Iranian hydrometallurgical zinc plants during the last few decades. Due to the low grades of zinc, lead, and silver in these residues, these residues have been abandoned without treatment.

pmc-11606889.description: Blackberry deteriorates rapidly after harvest due to its sensitive structure, limiting their storage time to about a week and resulting in significant economic losses. pmc-11644173.title: Effects of a 12 Week Ketogenic Diet Intervention on Obese and Overweight Females with Glucose and Lipid Metabolism Disturbance
pmc-11644173.creator: Grzegorz Klonek, Grzegorz Zydek, Robert Roczniok, Mariusz Panek, Adam Zając, Małgorzata Magdalena Michalczyk
pmc-11644173.description: Background/Objectives: We evaluated the effects of a 12-week hypocaloric ketogenic diet (KD) on glucose and lipid metabolism, as well as body mass, in overweight, obese, and healthy-weight females. One hundred adult females completed the study, including 64 obese (97.99 ± 11.48 kg), 23 overweight (75.50 ± 5.12 kg), and 11 with normal body mass (65.93 ± 3.40 kg).

pmc-12609920.title: Multimodal Structural Characterization of SARS-CoV-2 Spike Variants: Spectroscopic and Computational Insights
pmc-12609920.creator: Tiziana Mancini, Nicole Luchetti, Salvatore Macis, Velia Minicozzi, Rosanna Mosetti, Alessandro Nucara, Stefano Lupi, Annalisa D’Arco
pmc-12609920.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The SARS-CoV-2 pandemic has driven the emergence of many viral variants carrying multiple mutations, particularly in the spike glycoprotein, which enhance viral adaptability and may alter the structure and functionality of the protein. Here, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first systematic and comparative structural analysis of monomeric spike protein subunit 1 from three distinct SARS-CoV-2 variants at physiological pH (7.4).

pmc-12794110.title: The constrained disorder principle emphasizes the importance of variability boundaries for systems to function effectively
pmc-12794110.creator: Yaron Ilan
pmc-12794110.description: The Constrained Disorder Principle (CDP) defines systems by their inherent disorder, which is bounded by dynamic borders. This principle determines a system's functionality and efficiency based on its continuously changing boundaries. In this paper, we present the formulation of the principle using the equation B = F, where B represents the dynamic borders, and F denotes the system’s function.
